page.overview:
What is Chinchou?

Chinchou resembles a small deep-sea fish with an oval body, two small fin-like arms, a pair of stubby legs, and two long antennae tipped with yellow, bulb-shaped sacs. Chinchou also has two yellow eyes, each with a proton-shaped pupil.

Chinchou can release negatively charged electricity from its antennas for hunting, self-defense, and communication. These Pokémon live in schools of 20-30 individuals, though numerous groups numbering in the hundreds have been recorded during mating season. During this time, Chinchou head onto land en masse, where they perform intricate mating rituals involving the flashing and waving of their bulbs in patterns. People often come to see these spectacles, splashing Chinchou with water as they trek further inland to keep them hydrated. At the ends of these rituals, pairs of Chinchou head back into the water, lighting up the sea beautifully.

Chinchou evolves into Lanturn starting at level 27.

Max Raid Battle: East Lake Axewell, Giant's Cap, Giant's Mirror, Lake of Outrage, Motostoke Riverbank, North Lake Miloch, South Lake Miloch, West Lake Axewell
